proposed_widenings.name: FeatRecord / feat_root family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'feat' kind. Boon of Fate is a feat, not a spell, class_feature, or mastery. No honest encoding is possible until FeatRecord is added to the UnitRecord union and a corresponding mechanics family (or reuse of activation) is defined.

proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence { kind: 'initiative_or_short_or_long_rest' }
proposed_widenings.justification: The reset condition is 'until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.' Rolling initiative is not a rest event. The existing RestResetCadence variants (short_or_long_rest, long_rest, short_rest, partial_short_full_long) do not cover initiative-roll resets.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger { kind: 'any_d20_test' } or a new window atom 'd20_test_window'
proposed_widenings.justification: The trigger 'when you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test' is a broad post-roll event that covers attack rolls, saving throws, AND ability checks. The existing ReactionTrigger grammar (hit_by_attack_roll, targeted_by_named_spell, any_of) does not capture a generic D20 Test outcome trigger.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4...

proposed_widenings.name: DiceDelta with runtime sign choice (bonus or penalty)
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect allows the wielder to choose at invocation time whether 2d4 is a bonus (+) or penalty (-). The existing DiceDelta has a fixed authored sign. A variant expressing 'sign chosen at activation' is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll

notes: The primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord has no feat kind. The three secondary gaps (initiative reset cadence, D20 Test trigger, runtime sign choice) would each require surface widening even after feat kind is added. The Ability Score Increase benefit is out of scope for core mechanics per ARCHITECTURE.md.
